releaseNotes: Platform-to-engine execution adapter slice 3 completes the P0: Formation now imports the engine's verified results. The boundary report (core/adapters/platform-execution.ts) exports results[] — settled, accepted attempts from the durable run only, with evidence, artifact candidates by reference, and declared token budgets and cost estimates — plus per-artifact acceptance state. A node pending verification, a partially-accepted node, or a lane-seeded completion exports nothing; a seed fingerprint is not importable work.

The engine's staleness primitive is now wired: reconcilePatch runs invalidateDescendants whenever a re-produced output replaces a previously accepted fingerprint, so a changed accepted input transitively stales downstream nodes and un-accepts their outputs. An identical re-production invalidates nothing. The boundary's status overrides translate stale run nodes as upcoming work that will be redone, never as finished.

Formation's import (platform/server/domain/results.mjs) maps each verified result to a recommendation claim carrying the attempt's evidence — never an accepted fact — and each artifact candidate to a draft deliverable with an immutable version. Re-imports are idempotent; a newer verified attempt supersedes the old claim and appends a version without touching founder-authored title, status, or sections. Failed steps mirror as founder tasks that close when the engine recovers. Staleness marks exactly the engine-identified deliverables and clears when acceptance returns. Trace and cost metadata is copied field-by-field — ids, names, and declared totals only — so undeclared report fields never reach the store.
